parameters.content: Heavy job. Generates 100% original topic-to-video short: Windows SAPI narration, procedural 9:16 vertical video with animated progress bar, burned-in subtitles, host-side technical QA, and placement into human approval queue. Idempotent and bounded concurrency.

parameters.query: SELECT j.job_id, j.job_type, j.entity_id, j.correlation_id, j.payload, j.attempt, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, (ca_setting('original_generator_url','"http://localhost:9200"'))#>>'{}' AS generator_url FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = NULLIF(j.payload->>'channel_id','')::uuid WHERE j.job_id = $1::uuid AND j.status = 'running'

meta.note: Credentials are NOT embedded. After import, open each node showing a credential warning and select your own credential (see SETUP.md).
